scientific.integrity: The full open Bezdek--Litvak paper and the closely related Gluskin--Litvak full text were materially inspected. Candidate searches covered vertex-index, circumscribing-simplex, Minkowski-gauge, average-asymmetry, and simplex-difference-body formulations. The proof is exact and all-dimensional; the bundled computation is a regression check only.
limitations: The lower bound applies to outer polytopes with exactly d+1 vertices and does not determine the unrestricted vertex index.
The equality family of simplex difference bodies is not claimed to classify every equality body.
The Euclidean circumscribing-simplex inequality with the same numerical constant is prior work; the new statement is its arbitrary centrally symmetric norm extension.
Older Minkowski-asymmetry literature remains a residual source of possible equivalent formulations.

title: Sharp simplex-restricted vertex index for centrally symmetric bodies
